subject: general
question: A tangent is drawn from a point M to a circle, which meets the circle at T such that MT = 12 cm. A secant MAB intersects the circle at points A and B. If MA = 8 cm, what is the length ( in cm ) of the chord AB?
solution:
Given:

A tangent is drawn from point M to a circle, which meets the circle at T such that MT = 12 cm. 

A secant MAB intersects the circle at points A and B. 

MA = 8 cm

Concept used:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6d331545a1d233b336d143fa004555a7c61ec9b5e30bd771c1d717aeec308953.png] 

If SUV and SW are a secant and a tangent respectively drawn from an external point S on a circle whose center is at C, then SU × SV = SW2

Calculation:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b7687873306924758aa453eba36ae98c6eefb3ff219d670ba7fef6c78aca069.png] 

​According to the concept,

MA × MB = MT2

⇒ 8 × MB = 122

⇒ MB = 144/8

⇒ MB = 18

⇒ MA + AB = 18

⇒ 8 + AB = 18

⇒ AB = 18 - 8

⇒ AB = 10

∴ The measure of AB is 10 cm.
